package.name: anubis_bringup
package.description: Top-level bringup for Anubis -- tmux-based scripts that bring up every subsystem package together, for two operating modes: mapping (record a new map) and autonomous (localize + navigate against an existing map). Deployment on the robot itself is bare-metal (no Docker at runtime -- Docker is only used for development, on a separate devbox). See README.md for the full operating guide.
